description: Atlan is the context layer for enterprise AI. Connect ChatGPT to your organisation's context repos: the knowledge, data, and semantics your AI agents need to answer accurately. Use Atlan's agent skills to search and discover enterprise context, traverse end-to-end lineage, access governed data definitions and glossaries, execute SQL, curate your metadata graph, and ensure data quality, so every question you ask ChatGPT is grounded in trusted organisational context.
